# Atlas Query Insights, Performance Advisor and Compass explain — concept pack

> Performance Advisor is only available on M10+ clusters and Flex clusters; the Atlas-managed slow-query threshold is disabled on Free (M0) clusters and unsupported on clusters with MongoDB Search enabled. (from mongodb.com)
